name: Web Reviews
description: Read customer reviews from public review pages (Trustpilot, TripAdvisor, forums): with a managed browser, or for a site that blocks it from the Amazon Bedrock web index. Each page you add is its own source.

config.label: Pages per run (0 = all, up to 100)
Max reviews per run (0 = no limit, up to 5000)

setup.title: Web Reviews Setup
steps: Open the public review page you want to follow and copy its https URL
Add it above with a name and how many pages to read per run
Use Run now, or choose a frequency and enable the schedule

Read with Automatic (the default) tries the signed browser first; when the site blocks it or shows no reviews, the page's copy in the Amazon Bedrock web index (read by the model chosen in Administration → AI models, every review attributed)
If that finds nothing too, Automatic reads AgentCore web search snippets of the page, stored as excerpts. Each workspace learns which method works for each site and goes straight to it on later runs
Browser only or Bedrock web index only keeps a page on that one method; a site that no method can read is reported in the run status
